title: CGA-Bench: Clinical Guideline Adherence Benchmark (v6.0)
description:
CGA-Bench is a trace-level evaluation benchmark for medical AI agents, measuring adherence to time-sensitive clinical treatment protocols from 25 clinical practice guidelines (SSC 2021, AHA 2021/2019/2022, KDIGO, ADA, ESC 2020/2019, ATS/IDSA 2019, GOLD 2024, ACG 2021, ACLS 2020, AABB 2016, and others).

The benchmark comprises 1,049 typed constraints (REQUIRED, FORBIDDEN, BEFORE, WITHIN), 706 evaluation scenarios (107 manual + 599 auto-generated), and 16,944 agent episode traces across 8 LLM models. A strict scoring-agent information separation is enforced at the module level and verified via canary leakage scans.

Full documentation is provided in the accompanying repository, including the datasheet (DATASHEET.md), Responsible AI statement (docs/RAI.md), Croissant metadata (croissant.json), and reproducibility checklist.

Intended use: research evaluation of LLM agent adherence to clinical guidelines. NOT for direct clinical decision-making or training production clinical systems without independent validation.
